title: Rav Piltz Slams Torah Persecution
body: Rav Aviezer Piltz, rosh yeshiva of Tifrach, laments unprecedented persecution of Torah learners in Eretz Yisrael, calling it a "hunt" on Torah learning.

title: Rabbi Gershon Morgenstern Passes
body: Rabbi Gershon (George) Morgenstern z”l, 92, a man of determination, brilliance, and devotion to Torah and avodas Hashem, has passed away. Born in Brownsville, New York, he embodied authentic Torah life in a challenging era.
